headline: Liquor and food license requests, including transfers for Brandeis University and Tacos 502, and a Patriots game early opening.
summary: The meeting will cover one-day alcohol and entertainment permit requests, a request for early Sunday hours, and license transfers. It will also cover attendance requests for two licensees.
items: One-day all alcohol permit for Bentley University's Stokes Therapeutics event on October 20, 2026, in the Lacava Tent, with Sodexo Live catering for 100 people.
One-day entertainment permits for Charles River Museum of Industry and Innovation concerts on October 29, November 19, and December 3, 2026, plus the Annual Concert on December 18, 2026.
Extension of hours for Jake n Joe's Sports Grille for an early Sunday opening at 9:30am on November 15, 2026, before the New England Patriots game.
Update from the License Commission on the 7 day all alcohol restaurant license for Thirteen 05, Inc. d/b/a Rendezvous Restaurant, 592-596 Moody Street.
Transfer of common victualler license and change of manager from El Sabor Salvadoreno Namero 2 Corp to WEGA, LLC d/b/a Tacos 502, 137-139 Prospect Street, with William Garcia as new manager.
Transfers of liquor licenses from Brandeis University, 415 South Street, for the Faculty Club, the Usdan Center, and The Stein.
Attendance request for Absolutely Asia, which did not attend the Annual Mandatory meeting on October 15, 2026, for the 2027 renewal process.
Attendance request for Tessie's West, 841 Main Street, for the September 13, 2026 incident reported by the Waltham Police Department, report # 26030865.
location: Public Meeting Room, Arthur J. Clark Government Center, 119 School Street, Waltham
transcript:
# BOARD OF LICENSE COMMISSIONERS

CITY OF WALTHAM

MASSACHUSETTS

WAYNE F. BRASCO, CHAIRMAN

KEVIN RITCEY

KENNETH W. SUMNER

JOHN J. O'CONNOR III, ADMINISTRATIVE DIRECTOR

**Clerk's receipt stamp:** City of Waltham, Clerk's Office, date [unreadable]

## LEGAL NOTICE

## WEDNESDAY OCTOBER 28, 2026

## IN THE PUBLIC MEETING ROOM

*THE BOARD OF LICENSE COMMISSIONERS WILL HOLD A MEETING THAT WILL START AT 7:00 P.M. AT THE ARTHUR J. CLARK GOVERNMENT CENTER IN THE PUBLIC MEETING ROOM AT 119 SCHOOL STREET, WALTHAM. THE BOARD WILL HEAR THE FOLLOWING ISSUES AND OTHER MATTERS THAT MAY COME PROPERLY BEFORE THE BOARD.*

1. A request for a one-day all alcohol permit from Ken Levine representing Bentley University, 175 Forest Street, Waltham on Tuesday October 20, 2026, for the Stokes Therapeutics event in the Lacava Tent from 5:00pm to 6:30pm, Sodexo Live catering, 100ppl. pre-approved 09/28/26

2. Requests for one-day entertainment permits from Robert Perry representing the Charles River Museum of Industry and Innovation 154 Moody Street Waltham for the following 2nd Shift Concerts on Thursdays from 7:30pm-10:30pm, Premier Bar Service, 100ppl.

   - October 29, 2026 – Jesse Owwen Young
   - November 19, 2026 – Floyd Mercantile
   - December 3, 2026 - Holiday Duets with Sam Robbins & Halley Neal

   Annual Concert Friday December 18, 2026

   - Tarbox Ramblers Holiday Barnburner

3. A request for an extension of hours from Jake n Joe's Sports Grille for an early Sunday opening at 9:30am on November 15, 2026, to welcome guests for the New England Patriots game to enjoy food and beverages before kickoff.

4. A request from the License Commission for James Bakiika representing Thirteen 05, Inc. d/b/a Rendezvous Restaurant 592-596 Moody Street, Waltham to update the board on the 7 day all alcohol restaurant license.

5. An application request for a transfer of a common victualer license and change of manager from El Sabor Salvadoreno Namero 2 Corp to new WEGA, LLC. d/b/a Tacos 502 license is to be exercised on the premises known and numbered 137-139 Prospect Street consisting of approximately 865 sf 2 front doors and 1 rear door in kitchen and storage. New manager to be William Garcia.

6. Applications requests for transfer of various liquor licenses from Brandeis University, 415 South Street, Waltham 02453 for the following premises:

   - All-alcoholic beverages section 12 Club license from the Faculty Club Brandeis University Inc. to Brandeis University d/b/a The Faculty Club license is to be exercised on the premises known and numbered 415 South Street, Waltham MA 02453, consisting of one-story building in center of Brandeis University Campus. One main dining room, two small dining rooms, cocktail lounge manager to remain Susan Scannell.

   - All-alcoholic beverages section 12 Club license from Faculty Club Brandeis University, Inc. to new Brandeis University d/b/a Usdan Center license is to be exercised on the premises known and numbered 415 South Street, Waltham MA 02453, consisting of Ballroom on first floor and mezzanine level two lounges on second floor manager to remain Susan Scannell.

   - Wine and Malt beverages section of section 12 Club license from the Faculty Club Brandeis University, Inc. to new Brandeis University d/b/a The Stein license is to be exercised on the premises known and numbered 415 South Street, Waltham MA 02453 consisting of Three rooms and storage on the first floor, Function hall, Conference Room, and Lounge with Outdoor Patio consisting of 2640sf located in the Sherman Center manager to remain Susan Scannell.

7. A request for attendance from the License Commission for Licensee's that did not attend the Annual Mandatory meeting on October 15, 2026, for the Renewal process of 2027 for the following:

   - Absolutely Asia

8. A request for attendance from the License Commission for Tessie's West 841 Main Street, Waltham for the incident reported by the Waltham Police Department on September 13, 2026, report # 26030865.
